release: Global Findex 2025 · Länderdatei, geprüft am 9. September 2026

metrics.label: Ein Konto besitzen
metrics.note: Bank-, ähnliches Finanzinstituts- oder Mobile-Money-Konto; nicht zu einer Summe addieren.
metrics.sourceLabel: Account (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report having an account (by themselves or together with someone else) at a bank or similar financial institution (see the definition for "bank or similar financial institution account") or report personally using a mobile money service in the past year (see the definition for "mobile money account").

metrics.label: Konto bei einem Finanzinstitut
metrics.note: Eigener oder gemeinsamer Kontobesitz bei einer Bank oder einem ähnlichen Finanzinstitut.
metrics.sourceLabel: Bank or similar financial institution account (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report having an account (by themselves or together with someone else) at a bank or another similar financial institution.

metrics.label: Mobile Money nutzen
metrics.note: Persönliche Nutzung eines Mobile-Money-Dienstes im vergangenen Jahr; kein gewöhnliches Onlinebanking.
metrics.sourceLabel: Mobile money account (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report personally using a mobile money service in the past year.

metrics.label: Debitkarte nutzen
metrics.note: Veröffentlichte Nutzung einer Debitkarte; nicht mit dem Besitz einer Kreditkarte gleichsetzen.
metrics.sourceLabel: Used a debit card (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report using their own debit card to make a purchase in the past year.

metrics.label: Kreditkarte besitzen
metrics.note: Besitz einer Kreditkarte; keine Aussage über Schuldenhöhe oder Kartennutzung.
metrics.sourceLabel: Owns a credit card (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report having a credit card.

metrics.label: Kontostand digital prüfen
metrics.note: Kontostand im vergangenen Jahr per Mobiltelefon oder Internet geprüft.
metrics.sourceLabel: Used a mobile phone or the internet to check account balance(%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report using a mobile phone or the internet to check their balance for a bank or similar financial institution account in the past year.

metrics.label: Finanzinstitut zu weit entfernt
metrics.note: Kein Konto wegen großer Entfernung. Bezogen auf alle Erwachsenen, nicht nur Menschen ohne Konto.
metrics.sourceLabel: No account because bank or similar financial institutions are too far away (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report that they don't have a bank or similar financial institution account because bank or similar financial institutions are too far away.

metrics.label: Finanzdienste zu teuer
metrics.note: Kein Konto wegen hoher Kosten. Mehrere Gründe können gleichzeitig genannt werden.
metrics.sourceLabel: No account because financial services are too expensive (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report not having a bank or similar financial institution account because financial services are too expensive.

metrics.label: Erforderliche Dokumente fehlen
metrics.note: Kein Konto wegen fehlender Unterlagen, beispielsweise Ausweis oder Einkommensnachweis.
metrics.sourceLabel: No account because of a lack of necessary documentation (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report not having a bank or similar financial institution account because they lack the documentation needed to open one, such as an identity card, a wage slip, or the like.

metrics.label: Vertrauen fehlt
metrics.note: Kein Konto wegen fehlenden Vertrauens in Banken oder ähnliche Finanzinstitute.
metrics.sourceLabel: No account because of a lack of trust in bank or similar financial institutions (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report not having a bank or similar financial institution account because they do not trust bank or similar financial institutions.

metrics.label: Zu wenig Geld für ein Konto
metrics.note: Kein Konto wegen unzureichender finanzieller Mittel. Das ist keine amtliche Armutsquote.
metrics.sourceLabel: No account because of insufficient funds (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report not having a bank or similar financial institution account because they do not have enough money to use one.

metrics.label: Jemand in der Familie hat ein Konto
metrics.note: Kein eigenes Konto, weil bereits ein Familienmitglied eines besitzt.
metrics.sourceLabel: No account because someone in the family has one (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report not having a bank or similar financial institution account because someone else in their family already has one.

metrics.label: Digital gezahlt oder Geld erhalten
metrics.note: Mindestens eine digitale Zahlung gesendet oder empfangen; Personenanteil, kein Zahlungsvolumen.
metrics.sourceLabel: Made or received a digital payment (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report using mobile money, a debit or credit card, or a mobile phone to make a payment from an account--or report using the internet to pay bills or to buy something online or in a store--in the past year. This includes respondents who report paying bills, sending or receiving remittances, receiving payments for agricultural products, receiving government transfers, receiving wages, or receiving a public sector pension directly from or into a bank or similar financial institution account or through a mobile money account in the past year.

metrics.label: Digital bezahlt
metrics.note: Im vergangenen Jahr digital bezahlt oder Geld über ein Konto gesendet.
metrics.sourceLabel: Made a digital payment (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report using mobile money, a debit or credit card, or a mobile phone to make a payment from an account; or who report using the internet to pay bills or to buy something online or in a store in the past year. This includes respondents who report paying bills or sending remittances directly from a bank or similar financial institution account or through a mobile money account in the past year.

metrics.label: Digital Geld erhalten
metrics.note: Im vergangenen Jahr Geld digital erhalten, etwa Lohn, Überweisungen oder staatliche Zahlungen.
metrics.sourceLabel: Received digital payments (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report using a mobile money account, a debit or credit card, or a mobile phone to receive a payment into an account in the past year. This includes respondents who report receiving remittances, receiving payments for agricultural products, receiving government transfers, receiving wages, or receiving a public sector pension directly into a bank or similar financial institution account or into a mobile money account in the past year.

metrics.label: Beim Händler digital bezahlt
metrics.note: Im Geschäft per Karte oder Mobiltelefon beziehungsweise bei einem Onlinekauf digital bezahlt.
metrics.sourceLabel: Made a digital merchant payment (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report using a debit or credit card, or a mobile phone, to make a purchase in-store or to pay online for an internet purchase.

metrics.label: Rechnungen digital bezahlt
metrics.note: Im vergangenen Jahr Rechnungen per Mobiltelefon oder Internet beglichen.
metrics.sourceLabel: Used a mobile phone or the internet to pay bills (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report using a mobile phone or the internet to pay bills in the past year.

metrics.label: Online eingekauft
metrics.note: Im vergangenen Jahr per Mobiltelefon oder Internet etwas gekauft. Das misst keine Umsätze des Onlinehandels.
metrics.sourceLabel: Used a mobile phone or the internet to buy something online (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report using a mobile phone or the internet to buy something online in the past year.

metrics.label: Geld zurückgelegt
metrics.note: Im vergangenen Jahr auf irgendeine Weise gespart oder Geld zurückgelegt; kein Sparbetrag.
metrics.sourceLabel: Saved any money (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report personally saving or setting aside any money for any reason and using any mode of saving in the past year.

metrics.label: Über ein Konto gespart
metrics.note: Bei einer Bank, einem ähnlichen Finanzinstitut oder über Mobile Money gespart.
metrics.sourceLabel: Saved at a bank or similar financial institution or using a mobile money account (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report saving or setting aside any money at a bank or similar financial institution or using a mobile money account to save in the past year.

metrics.label: Für das Alter gespart
metrics.note: Von der Quelle veröffentlichtes Sparen für das Alter; keine Höhe oder ausreichende Altersvorsorge.
metrics.sourceLabel: Saved for old age (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report saving formally and saving or setting aside any money in the past year for old age.

metrics.label: Geld geliehen
metrics.note: Im vergangenen Jahr aus irgendeiner Quelle Geld geliehen; keine Schuldenquote.
metrics.sourceLabel: Borrowed any money (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report borrowing any money (by themselves or together with someone else) for any reason and from any source in the past year.

metrics.label: Über Finanzdienste geliehen
metrics.note: Kredit von einem Finanzinstitut, per Kreditkarte oder Mobile Money; keine ausstehende Kreditsumme.
metrics.sourceLabel: Borrowed any money from a formal bank or similar financial institution or using a mobile money account (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report borrowing any money from a bank or similar financial institution, or using a credit card, or using a mobile money account in the past year.

metrics.label: Bei Familie oder Freunden geliehen
metrics.note: Im vergangenen Jahr Geld von Familie, Verwandten oder Freunden geliehen.
metrics.sourceLabel: Borrowed from family or friends (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report borrowing any money from family, relatives, or friends in the past year.

metrics.label: Notgeld beschaffen möglich
metrics.note: Nach eigener Einschätzung den im Fragebogen genannten Notbetrag innerhalb von 30 Tagen beschaffen können.
metrics.sourceLabel: Coming up with emergency funds in 30 days: possible (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who say it is possible--whether"difficult,""somewhat difficult,"or"not very difficult"--for them to come up with the emergency funds in 30 days.

metrics.label: Notgeld nicht als möglich angegeben
metrics.note: Enthält laut Quelle auch „weiß nicht“ und verweigerte Antworten; nicht ausschließlich nachgewiesene Unmöglichkeit.
metrics.sourceLabel: Coming up with emergency funds in 30 days: not possible (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who say it is not possible for them to come up with the emergency funds in 30 days. This includes people who say do not know or refused.

metrics.label: Notgeld ohne Schwierigkeiten
metrics.note: Den genannten Notbetrag innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach eigener Einschätzung ohne Schwierigkeiten beschaffen können.
metrics.sourceLabel: Coming up with emergency funds in 30 days: possible and not difficult at all (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who say it is possible and not difficult at all for them to come up with the funds in 30 days.

metrics.label: Notgeld aus Ersparnissen
metrics.note: Ersparnisse als hauptsächliche Notgeldquelle, wenn Beschaffung innerhalb von 30 Tagen möglich ist. Nenner sind alle Erwachsenen.
metrics.sourceLabel: Main source of emergency funds in 30 days: savings (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who say it is possible for them to come up with emergency funds in 30 days and list savings as their main source of emergency funds.

metrics.label: Notgeld von Familie oder Freunden
metrics.note: Familie, Verwandte oder Freunde als hauptsächliche Notgeldquelle. Keine tatsächlich erfolgte Überweisung.
metrics.sourceLabel: Main source of emergency funds in 30 days: family or friends (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who say it is possible for them to come up with emergency funds in 30 days and list family, relatives, or friends as their main source of emergency funds.

metrics.label: Notgeld durch Arbeit
metrics.note: Arbeit als hauptsächliche Quelle für einen kurzfristigen Notbetrag. Selbstbericht, kein gesichertes zukünftiges Einkommen.
metrics.sourceLabel: Main source of emergency funds in 30 days: work (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who say it is possible for them to come up with emergency funds in 30 days and list money from working as their main source of emergency funds.

metrics.label: Lohn auf ein Konto erhalten
metrics.note: Lohn im vergangenen Jahr auf ein Finanzinstitutskonto, eine Karte oder per Mobiltelefon erhalten; Nenner sind alle Erwachsenen.
metrics.sourceLabel: Received wages: into an account (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report receiving any money from an employer in the past year in the form of a salary or wages for doing work, and who received it directly into a bank or similar financial institution account, into a card, or through a mobile phone.

metrics.label: Staatliche Zahlung auf ein Konto
metrics.note: Transfer, öffentliche Rente oder Staatslohn auf ein Konto, eine Karte oder per Mobiltelefon erhalten.
metrics.sourceLabel: Received government payments: into an account (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report personally receiving payments from the government (government transfers, public sector pension, or public sector wages) in the past year directly into a bank or similar financial institution account, into a card, or through a mobile phone.

metrics.label: Agrarerlöse auf ein Konto erhalten
metrics.note: Erlöse aus Agrarprodukten, Ernten oder Vieh auf ein Konto, eine Karte oder per Mobiltelefon erhalten.
metrics.sourceLabel: Received payments for agricultural products: into an account (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report personally receiving money from any source for the sale of agricultural products, crops, produce, or livestock in the past year directly into a bank or similar financial institution account, into a card, or through a mobile phone.

metrics.label: Geld innerhalb des Landes gesendet oder erhalten
metrics.note: Geld an beziehungsweise von Familie oder Freunden in einem anderen Landesteil; unterschiedliche Vorgänge können dieselben Personen betreffen.
metrics.sourceLabel: Sent or received domestic remittances (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report personally sending or receiving any of their money in the past year to or from a relative or friend living in a different area of their country.

metrics.label: Inländisches Geld über Konten transferiert
metrics.note: Solche inländischen Überweisungen über ein Finanzinstituts- oder Mobile-Money-Konto abgewickelt.
metrics.sourceLabel: Sent or received domestic remittances: using an account (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report personally sending or receiving any of their money in the past year to or from a relative or friend living in a different area of their country, and sent or received the money using a bank or similar financial institution account or a mobile money account.

metrics.label: Geld aus dem Ausland erhalten
metrics.note: Im vergangenen Jahr internationale Rücküberweisungen erhalten; Personenanteil, kein Geldbetrag.
metrics.sourceLabel: Received international remittances  (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report they recieved international remittances in the past year.

metrics.label: Ein Mobiltelefon besitzen
metrics.note: Ein eigenes Mobiltelefon für persönliche Anrufe besitzen; kein Zählen von SIM-Karten oder Verträgen.
metrics.sourceLabel: Own a mobile phone (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report owning a mobile phone that they use to make and receive personal calls.

metrics.label: Internet genutzt
metrics.note: Internet in den vergangenen drei Monaten genutzt; andere Bezugsperiode als die WDI-Internetreihe.
metrics.sourceLabel: Used the internet in the past three months (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report that they used the internet in the past three months.

metrics.label: Smartphone als Haupttelefon
metrics.note: Das hauptsächlich genutzte Mobiltelefon ist ein Smartphone; Nenner sind alle Erwachsenen.
metrics.sourceLabel: Main mobile phone is a smartphone (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report that the main mobile phone they use is a smartphone.

metrics.label: Online gelernt
metrics.note: In den vergangenen drei Monaten online Informationen zum Lernen oder zur Weiterbildung aufgerufen.
metrics.sourceLabel: Accessed online info to learn/train/educate in past three months (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report that they accessed information online to learn, train, or educate themselves or someone else in the past three months.

metrics.label: Mit Apps oder Webseiten verdient
metrics.note: In den vergangenen drei Monaten Apps oder Webseiten zum Geldverdienen genutzt; kein gemessenes Einkommen.
metrics.sourceLabel: Used apps/websites to earn money in past three months (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report that they used apps or websites to earn money—for example, by selling goods or services online—in the past three months.

metrics.label: Staatliche Informationen online genutzt
metrics.note: In den vergangenen drei Monaten staatliche Dienste oder Informationen online genutzt.
metrics.sourceLabel: Accessed government services/info online in past three months (%, age 15+)
metrics.sourceDefinition: The percentage of respondents who report that they accessed government services or searched for government information online in the past three months.
